batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b A Mishra

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b A Mishra

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b PP Ojha

batting.dismissal: c R Sathish b KA Pollard

batting.name: DT Christian
batting.dismissal: st DJ Jacobs b MM Patel

balls.text: now he does a Symonds, Dan tries the yorker, but misses by the narrowest of margins, rohit transfers the weight on back foot at the right moment, and muscles it straight back at the bowler, who is floored on the ground with the force of the hit, and the ball splits long on and long off perfectly, 24 in the last over, Mumbai have surged to 172
another one, the IPL belongs to Rohit, gets to his 50, Dan helps with a full toss on leg stump, and Rohit kills it over midwicket
Rohit is middling everything now, again stands stone-still and mows a length ball over midwicket, he follows the line closely and swings it with the angle in to the crowd
tries to back away and hammer this one, but Dan follows him and he squeezes it past short fine leg
bunted down to long off for a single
Mumbai showing their class, Rohit gets a low full toss outside off, he is more conventional than Symonds, stands still and hammers it over long off with a huge swing
good comeback from Steyn, fires in the yorker close to off, Symonds tries to squeeze it away but ends up playing inside the line
can't get this one away for once, Steyn sprays it wide outside off stump, Symonds stretches out but can't get to it from outside leg

Steyn is being taken apart, again Symonds gets outside leg, this one is just short of a length, enough room for Symonds to punch it past  extra cover, more timing than muscle power on this one, the result is the same
this time he splits sweeper cover and third man with the back-away-and-hammer technique of his, gets another couple as he screams back with monster strides

he is not done, now he makes more room outside leg, Steyn follows him with a pacy length ball, but Symonds adjusts to hammer it over the straight boundary even as long on desperately runs across but can do nothing
hammered! Symonds stands in the crease and muscles a short of a length ball over extra cover, gets front leg out of the way and tonks it to the boundary
Symonds makes room to a length ball and crashes it past point but third man is pretty square for him, and tidies up on the boundary
Ishant manages to get his huge frame down in time to stop a screaming straight hit from Symonds, it was travelling but he got his left hand to it
Ishant sprays it short and wide but Rohit cannot get it away, cuts it wide of sweeper cover but not wide enough to beat him
mistimes the big hit in to the leg side, they cross over for the single
Symonds gets the full toss away this time, makes room and dismisses it wide of sweeper cover, when he middles them, the field need not move
full toss from ishant, Rohit murders it with a huge swing but there is a man at long off
gets two this time, another one squeezed away wide of third man and Symonds comes hustling back for two
squeezed away from outside off and the ball flies to third man
smart work, Rohit shuffles across to a slower one, gets outside off and helps it over short fine leg, ends up on a leg himself
consistently targettting the deep point boundary is Symonds, backs away again and tries to muscle a low full toss, gets it away to third man
gets this one through point but it picked up close to the boundary by the man running across
makes room outside leg and swings a fuller one straight back, too straight as it crashes in to rohit's stumps
backs away and looks for the big shot over the off side infield, Ishant follows him with a fuller one and he bunts it towards extra cover
short of a length now, gets up slowly outside off, Rohit punches wide of extra cover
another one angled in, but this one is short, allows Rohit, who was already outside leg, to help it on its way fine, one hand came off the bat but he only needed to some bat on it, which he did
in to the pads with the angle, Symonds can't work it away and gets it towards point off the pads
flicked uppishly bit bounces in front of midwicket
Rohit swivels and splits the field on the leg side boundary with a pull that beats the man diving in from deep mdidwicket
goes for the big one, ends up slicing it from the crease as it turns away, but Symonds manages to beat three men converging on the ball, bounces just in front of the closest man, sweeper cover
turns one from the pads through square leg, the man runs in from the boundary and keeps them to a single
sees him coming out and bowls it shorter and flatter, Symonds manages to get some bat on it towards short third man as it almost rushes past him
this one is very full outside off, Rohit flows in to a lovely cover drive along the ground
this one is tossed up, bounces wide outside off, Rohit cannot get the cut past point again
flat and turning away from a length, he stays back and cuts quickly, but straight to backward point
looks to make room outside leg, sees this one angled in, and adjusts to stylishly whip it down to long on
118.7 kph slower and fuller one, Symonds creams it with minimum of fuss, and long off is in business
waits for a length ball angled in and works it in front of midwicket
steered away for a single to third man
swat! Symonds brings out the tennis forehand, comes down the track, takes on a short one and forehands it with lots of brute power way over mid off
Symonds backs away outside leg in typical fashion and chops a length ball from middle stump wide of third man
takes another couple with a tuck through midwicket, good over for Mumbai, Ojha has bowled out
makes him reach out with a flighted one, he stretches forward and pushes to extra cover
smart batting from rohit, nudges in front of midwicket, there is no one on that area in the circle, and he comes back for the second
this time Rohit gets one away, lunges forward for the slog sweep and gets it in front of square leg for a boundary
tossed up and sliding on, pushed away off the front foot, tight stuff from Ojha
driven along the ground for another single, to long on
clipped off middle and leg towards midwicket, Ishant runs in from long on and keeps them to a single
comes forward and creams a fuller one, but there is a man at sweeper cover
the short ball takes off, but it is quite outside off and he can leave comfortably
pins him on the back foot with a length ball that bounces a bit, he guides it to backward point;s left who dives and parries the ball towards gully who throws at the non-striker;s but misses
chopped down to third man for a single
144.5 kph fuller on outside off, he pushes it back to Steyn who fires in the throw back, just past the batsman
hurries on with the angle, super bowling from Mishra, Symonds keeps bat and [ad close together and manages to stab it away
short,wide and keeping low, Rohit bashes it to sweeper cover
this one comes back in, Symonds adjusts hurriedly to tuck it in front of square leg
tossed up, he pushes it back to the bowler
pushed off the front foot towards extra cover
punched off the back foot to extra cover
appeal for lbw as the arm ball strikes him on the pads on the back foot, but it was going down leg
drives through the line of one turning away and gets the single to long off
flighted and turning away, he comes forward and pushes on the off side
cut hard off the back foot but point dives and stops the ball,
lovely bowling from Ojha, tossed up around off, Rohit looks to comes forward the decides to remain back and push it away to point

Mumbai are crumbling here, Pollard goes first ball, he goes across and bends for a cute paddle sweep to a ball around middle, gets a top edge that loops weakly on the leg side and Sanga safely pouches it
pushed down on the leg side but Mishra dives on the practice pitch and stops the ball
pushed away calmly off the front foot  on the leg side

Mishra strikes again, Rayudu goes for the sweep to a flat delivery that came quickly on to him, he got the connection alright but the ball flew flat off the blade, and Dhawan at deep square leg timed the leap perfectly to hold on to a superb catch
pushed away in to the leg side

Sachin has holed out to Steyn at long on, or has he? lovely bowling from Mishra, drew Sachin out with a flighted delivery that he bowled with a wrist more cocked that usual, even as Sachin came out it dipped on him, and he was not close to the pitch as he swung hard, the ball climbed miles but settled in to Steyn;s hands at long on, they check for the no-ball but Sachin has to walk back in the end
Rayudu pushes forward and chips against the turn high over midwicket, too much risk for the single
another one gets a bit big on Rayudu, he manages to keep it down on the leg side
now he shuffles way across the stumps and whips this one to fine leg
angled in short outside leg stump, Sachin makes even more room and tries to upper cut it, but misses
gets one that rises on him from back of a length, Rayudu somehow fends it on the off side and rushes across for the single
angled in on the pads, and Sachin uses the angle to work it away to fine leg
short of a length outside off and smashed off the back foot, but right to extra cover
now Rayudu pushes it wide of long on for a comfortable couple
flatter on the pads, he goes down on the knee for the sweep and swings the ball to fine leg
flighted generously, Rayudu comes out and pushes it with a straight blade, and Ojha;s dive cannot prevent the single
charges out, Ojha fires it in, SAchin adjusts to push it down to long on
fired down the leg side with the angle
pushed slower through the air, Rayudu waits and then plonks it on the leg side for a single
comes outside the crease and tucks a short of a length ball off the pads to square leg
tries to nudge one of the pads past the keeper, but the ball loops in the air close to the wicket on the leg side
another flippy flick from Sachin to a fuller one on leg, this one goes right to midwicket
bangs it in short, but Sachin weaves outside the line and Ishant goes down leg
another one, this one over extra cover, takes a step out and lofts a length ball over the infield, Sachin has taken over from where Davy left
whipped away off the pads in the air, and fine leg had no chance, waited for it to angle in and sent it flying with a wristly whip and a big followthrough
just short of a length and Sachin drives on the up but the ball goes straight towards point

Davy goes this time, came down the track to hammer a short of a length ball over the straight boundary, but got a top edge that swirled in the air past Ojha at mid on who did well to run back and take the catch comfortably
gets on top of this short of a length ball, but cannot get it away, gets a single on the leg side
full toss from Dan, Davy meets a step outside the crease and bashes it past the non-striker's stumps, and just over the umpire, Mumbai are running away at the moment
very full from Dan, almost yorker length, but super work from Davy, makes a lot of room outside leg, and brings down bat just in time to squeeze the ball past point
a fuller wobbling one from Dan this time, Sachin forces it past the bowler, but mid off gets to it with a dive
Sachin pings mid off, showing the full face of the blade to a length ball, Dav wants the single, but mid off gets to the ball and Sachin sends him back
full and angled in on the pads, whipped away square for a single
Ishant bowls a full toss on leg stump, but Davy cannot get it away, flicks furiously but there is a man now at deep square leg
now Ishant pitches a bit short, Davy takes him on with the charge and swing-pulls him to the deep backward square leg boundary
he has been corking up those wrists to do exactly this, gets a length ball around off and uncorks the wrists to hammers it between extra cover and mid off
145.6 kph from Ishant, this time Sachin skips down the track, adjusts as this one bounces extra and tucks it in front of square leg
stays back this time to a length ball with those cocked wrists, and tries to smash it through midwicket, but misses as he gets an inside edge on to pad
and right away, he is greeted with a charge and a heave by Davy, who does not connect cleanly, and gets a bottom edge towards square leg
keeps the strike with a single down towards mid on
he had decided this one had to disappear, came charging out, was not that close to the pitch of the ball, but gave it a huge swing, and dispatched the ball over the straight boundary
tossed up this time, it turns away and he defends off the front foot
a touch shortish, Davy rocks back and goes for the cut, but cannot beat point
again takes a step out and flicks wide of midwicket, this time for a single
Sachin rushes outside his crease, takes this one on the half volley and flicks it through midwicket, there is man in the deep but he is not looking to allow any bowler to settle
144.7 kph, a bit further up compared to the previous one and Davy goes hard at it, but under edges it in to the ground on the off side
Steyn gets it right for the first time this over, good length outside off and screaming away after pitching, Davy wisely leaves it alone
the ball is flying off Sachin's bat, talk about using the bowler;s pace, shuffles and tucks a short of a length ball to fine leg
another boundary, but past the keeper and to the fine leg boundary, Sachin saw this one dropped back of a length and went for the forcing cut, got a bottom edge that easily beat the keeper
shot! waits for a fuller one to move away from a fuller length, and pings extra cover with a perfect front foot drive
and right away, Sachin walks across and two steps outside the crease, takes a length ball from just outside off and whips it in front of square leg, it flies off the middle of the bat
the flatter and quicker googly from outside off stump, he rocks back and cuts it to point
Davy gets the reverse paddle away, it was full outside off, nice length for that shot, he went down on the knee and helped it past short third man with those powerful wrists
the tossed up googly, he comes out and takes it on the pads
similar delivery, this time he waits for an instant, and tucks it in front of square to get off the mark
loud shout first up to Sachin, it is the one that goes straight on, he misses and is struck on the pads, not given, could have been going down leg
tossed up slowly around off, watchfully eased past the bowler
Mishra is the man that Mumbai could not out at all, he goes back to one angled across him, and gets the late dab easily past Pollard at short third man who accompanies it to the boundary
Mishra plays a delicate late dab that goes straight to short third man
Mishra sees Harbhajan give it air from round the stumps, charges out and has a mighty heave, misses, Davy misses it too, that was quick from Harbhajan
tossed up slowly, he pushes it in the air down the ground on the off side
comes forward and pushes this one, Sachin with the diving stop at extra cover that is cheered wildly
full from round the stumps worked backward of square leg
goes for the pull to a short one that climbs on to him, the top edge lands safely beyond square leg

now Mishra eases in to the extra cover drive, high elbow and all, but this time Mumbai have the run out, Steyn had backed up mid-pitch and had not chance of making it back as the throw came in to the bowler who did well to come up to the stumps
low full toss angled in, worked on the leg side
Mumbai continue to smash the stumps, this time it is Sachin from midwicket, Mishra had done well to rock back and work a yorker towards Sachin
Steyn leans in to the drive wide of mid off, another direct hit from Mumbai, Steyn has just made it as the bails come off
sprays this one wide down leg with the angle
Mishra displaying his range now, swings a back of a length ball on one leg to Malinga at fine leg
for once the yorker machine goes wrong, this one ends up as a low full toss on the pads, and Steyn nudges it fine with the angle
Mishra gives Malinga the charge, and gets this one down to long on with a big swipe
works a 143.1 kph full delivery towards midwicket, Steyn takes off but is sent back just in time
reaches out to stab a low full toss outside off in front of point, Mishra has to hurry but the throw misses
digs out a fuller one towards mid on
Malinga continues to sling them in, this one goes off the leading edge towards point
gets a leading edge as he tries to turn a length ball from middle stump to the leg side
Mishra gets another one away, Munaf helps him by bowling a fuller one on the pads, and he flicks it fine stylishly to the boundary, Mohnish is not the only Mishra who can bat
gets bat in front of pad to flick a low full toss through midwicket
clips this one for a single towards midwicket now
consecutive boundaries for Deccan, Mishra stays in the crease and lifts a length ball high over extra cover
squeezes a full and very wide one, and gets it down fine to the third man boundary
almost another wicket, low full toss at 140.5 kph, Steyn pushes it weakly but the ball falls just short of the man coming in from mid off
pushes a full ball off the front foot on the off side
the yorker right away, goes under his legs as he shuffles across

not only do the yorkers get him the wicket, now even the batsman's expectation of a yorker does so, stands pinned in the crease, Malinga bowls a slow full toss, he belatedly tries to push it on the leg side, and gets it off the leading edge of the bat straight to Malinga
balls.dismissal: DB Ravi Teja — caught and bowled

balls.text: goes deep in the crease and whips another full ball in the air over square leg
caught on the back foot expecting the yorker, pats away a fuller one on the off side
Munaf tries the short one, he tries to have a go at it and misses as it bounces
gets on the toes and works this one off the pads to fine leg

super work from Davy, Munaf gets this one to bounce from a length, Dan has a swipe at it, misses and goes outside the crease with the momentum, overbalances and is late in getting the back leg down, it's still in the air as Davy collects it cleanly and whips off the bails, stumped off a seamer, this is not Dan's night
134.7 kph fuller one swerving away from close to the stumps, he can't do anything with it as he had backed away
bowls a low full toss way outside off, and he takes toll, slicing it over and between short third man and backward point
makes room to hit it through extra cover, but gets it off the toe end to point
this one chooses leg stump as its destination, but Teja somehow gets a bit if bat on it to get it towards midwicket
128 kph slower one arrives after all those yorkers, he squeezes it from outside off to third man
almost another one, there is no getting away, once more Malinga homes in on middle, he shuffles and manages to stab it on the leg side

Malinga goes through his former captain, Sanga backs away again a long way outside leg stump, looking to squeeze it away on the off side, Malinga lets the slinging delivery rip, it ends up as a very low full toss that crashes in to middle stump, close to the base, Malinga just puts his finger up in muted celebration
this one ends up as a full delivery, he swings it down to long on for the single
Sanga backs away way outside leg, Malinga fires in the yorker on leg stump and Sanga just about squeezes it away towards covers
this one does not get up much from back of a length, Sanga does not get the power on the pull but picks up two in front of square leg
fuller one worked down the ground, mid off charges to his right and fields
banged in short, and he goes for a forcing pull, mistimes it but manages to get it over midwicket
clatter! out of nowhere, Christian abandons all niceties like glides and pushes, and lifts a length ball from outside off over wide long on, that was absolutely smoked
cannot get this shortish one away, guides it to point, comes out but is not getting the run
stabs away a fuller delivery on the off side but Nechim runs across to field it quickly
pushed through flat and across the batsman who shuffles and works it to midwicket, the asking rate is approaching 12
goes straight on and bounce on Sanga who adjusts to punch in the air to long on
takes this one on the full but hits it right to extra cover on the edge of the circle
pushes forward for a single in front of covers
slashes at a flat one from wide outside off, another diving stop, at short third man from Nechim
turns in from off stump and he works it away to fine leg
tries to punch a slower one away, ends up pushing it in the air back to the bowler
clips a full delivery angled on the pads, Rayudu rushes in from deep midwicket and stops the second this time
digs this fuller one back to the bowler
gentle but effective stuff at the moment from Sathish, this one is pushed through midwicket
angled full on the pads, and he works it away towards the vacant midwicket area, but Sathish charges after the ball, dives an keeps them to a single
waits on the slower one and chips it over the bowler and down to long on
pushed off the front foot to long off
short of a length on the pads, he swipes it through square leg
short and wide, but Pollard gets a wicket instead of disappearing in to the deep point boundary, Chipli waits and waits on it, and cuts it straight to backward point at a nice height
almost scoops this one from the pads to Pollard, who charges towards the ball but can't get to it as it bounces mid-pitch
drives off the front foot for a single towards extra cover now
Pollard continues to leak runs, serves up a short one down leg, and Sanga helps it to the fine leg boundary
pushed back to the bowler
98 kph slower one that is full outside off, he gets forward and smashes it, goes through extra cover and runs in to the boundary
gets forward to one going across and pings sweeper cover with the drive
slowly cutting in from leg stump, Sanga works it in to the gap wide of deep midwicket and picks up two
worked backward of square leg for a single
almost gets a wicket first ball, he punches off the back foot, Symonds moves forward at extra cover, but the ball bounces just in front
forces this one off the back foot wide of Sachin at extra cover
strays wide down leg with the angle
at 126.6 kph, Pollard tests the bounce in the pitch, gets one to take off from short of a length, Chipli hops and weaves away from the line
gentle short of a length ball on leg stump, Sanga works it square for a single
White can't buy a run, he gets forward and manages to drive wide of Malinga at mid off, who gets to the ball and lets it rip, catching White inches short
pushes this one in front of midwicket
now this one is short and wide outside off stump, Sanga goes hard at it, and the outside edge flies past the keeper, Pollard getting some bounce
short of a length and down the leg side right away
Sanga shuffles and whips a pacy length ball off the pads, but Munaf at short fine leg does his version of the diving stop, scrambling to the ground to stop the ball somehow
almost gets through him, fuller on the middle stump, squares him up and he gets a thick edge to third man
he can't swat a fly by the looks of it at the moment, tries to hammers a short of a length ball outside off, ends up hitting it in the ground
looks to punch a length ball close to off stump, Sachin fields at extra cover
whippy length ball at 141.5 kph angled in, White manages to push it away ungainly on the leg side
worked away off the pads in front of square leg
127.9 kph fuller delivery slanted wide outside off stump, White tries to run it down to third man but misses by a mile
another yorker, no chance for White in this form to do anything about it, fortunately for him, it is just outside off stump, just

and Malinga does the inevitable, took him four balls this time, fires in the yorker, Shikhar was making room outside leg, and ended up losing his leg stump as bat came down too late, now then, how many times have we seen that?
122.7 kph slower one going across Shikhar, he almost ends up driving it to extra cover, falls well short in the end
another low full toss, Sanga shuffles and pushes it towards mid on
low full toss, right away in search of the yorker. driven towards covers where a diving stop saves some runs
whips it back to the bowler, who gets a boot to it, and slows it down, gets to it but is not quick enough to prevent the tun
continues to pitch it full, he shuffles and clips it away to Harbhajan at mid on
clears the front leg and tries to hammer a full delivery away, but again ends up slogging it, this time to long on
whips off the pads wide of Munaf at deep midwicket. charges back for the second, Munaf;s throw is a bit wide and he makes it back safely
tries to repeat the shot again, too much bottom hand and he ends up slogging it to Sachin at mid on
and Sanga thumps him past the non-striker;s stumps right away, takes the fuller one and belts it past the bowler
Sanga skips down the track, gets a quicker one on the pads and flicks it to Sachin at short fine leg who again fires in the throw quickly to the keeper
pushed away down the ground on the leg side
gets the sweep away this time, but straight to square leg
rocks back and gets the cut right from middle stump in the gap between short third man and backward point
tries to go for the sweep, he bowls it flatter and quicker, Shikhar adjusts to work it in front of square leg
angled in on the left-hander;s pads, tucked to square leg where Symonds hustles to stop the single
tries to dab it late past short third man, but does not get the timing right
shuffles across the stumps and picks this one off the pads to fine leg
still wider outside off goes Munaf, this time Shikhar tries to muscles it away through extra cover, but mistimes it in to the ground
again, touch wider from Munaf, so Shikhar goes wider of Harbhajan at mid off, who dives over the ball and Shikhar gets another boundary

lovely drive from Shikhar, would have pleased SAnga as well, Shikhar took a step out, and met the ball going across him with the full face of the straight bat, and split the gap between extra cover and mid off
length ball on the pads, Sanga whips it away to deep square leg
tossed up slowly from round the stumps, and straightening around middle, Sanga shuffles and tucks it in front of square to get off the mark

Mumbai's much-talked about fielding gets them the early breakthrough, it was cut towards point from where Pollard fired in an accurate throw, DAvy had the bails off to catch sohal just short of his ground
Dhawan is ready for the reverse dab, this one turns slightly outside off, and bounces a bit, but Shikhar adjusted to wrist it away, beating Munaf who tottered after it to the third man boundary
guides a quicker one to Sachin at short third man, loud roar as Sachin fires in the throw to the keeper
bounces and goes straight on outside off from round the wicket, he cuts but point dives and parries the ball away
bowls it fuller outside off stump, and he flows in to the front foot drive in the gap through covers
moving further away from a length outside off, he tries to glide it away to third man but misses
bends the knee and flows in to the cut off the front foot, but cannot beat backward point again
128.1 kph from Munaf, Dhawan cannot beat Pollard at point with the punch
neat work from Shikhar, gets forward to a length ball going across, and opens the face to run it past slip
gets width, it is short way outside off, but Shikhar cuts it right to backward point
back of a length around off right away, steered to third man
